mxdhu.__ on October 3, 2026: "I tried a new foundation after so long !!! Comment for the link 🔗 
Shade - 201 

A few things I noticed after wearing it for the whole day 👀

It does oxidise a little around half to one shade deeper. I got 8+ hours of wear, which was pretty impressive! If you have oily skin, you might see some oil peeking through after a few hours, so just keep a compact handy.

On my combination skin, it felt comfortable, not cakey or heavy, and still kept that dewy, glowy finish ✨
